svg.title: Idea thumbnails
svg.text: One theme, six quick ideas. Sketch in 3 to 5 minutes each, then pick the one you can read in one second from 3 meters. Lesson 09.1.
Must measure 10 cm. If not, print at 100% ("Actual size").
Red dotted ovals: eye area. Plan only eye-safe products there, and no gems or glitter near the lashes.
